conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower volatility but also more modest returns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth by using and adding leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, rotating into income-focused ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting high-beta names. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
